title: Care team scheduling synthesis
subtitle: Shift planning handoff demo
summary: Managers need a reviewable artifact that combines findings, quotes, a priority matrix and provenance without losing source IDs.

sections.title: Where scheduling breaks down
sections.body: Coordinators can keep the week staffed, but exception handling is still spread across chat, calls and local spreadsheets.

sections.title: What the next workflow must support
sections.body: The most useful handoff is a concrete review packet: findings, quotes, decisions and a table that can be checked before rollout.

findings.title: Coverage gaps are found too late
findings.summary: Teams discover uncovered visits during manual review instead of during planning.

evidence.quote: The hard part is not making a plan, it is finding the exception before Friday.

findings.title: Review burden blocks adoption
findings.summary: Any new automation must produce something managers can inspect and correct.

evidence.quote: If I cannot see what changed, I will copy it back into my own sheet.

quotes.speaker: Scheduling coordinator
quotes.text: I need the weekly plan and the exceptions in one place.
